CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
